job.job_description:
What youll do (practical, hands-on)
Design, write, and iterate on prompts for LLMs across various use cases like content generation and automation.
Test and evaluate prompt outputs for accuracy, relevance, tone, and consistency.
Apply prompt engineering techniques like zero-shot, few-shot, and chain-of-thought prompting.
Work with AI platforms and APIs including OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, and Mistral.
Contribute to developing training materials and workshops on prompt engineering for students.
Evaluate AI-generated content for quality, bias, safety, and alignment with goals.
Must-have (non-negotiable)
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Linguistics, or a related field.
Hands-on familiarity with AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Midjourney.
Basic understanding of how LLMs work tokens, temperature, context windows.
Exceptional written communication and language skills in English.
Strong logical thinking and structured problem-solving ability.
Nice-to-have
Personal AI projects, experiments, or a GitHub portfolio showcasing AI/prompt work.
Familiarity with vector databases, embeddings, or RAG concepts.
Experience with image generation tools like Midjourney or DALLE.
Online certification in AI, ML, or prompt engineering.
